question: On Saturday morning a repair cafe had 98 tools on the bench, and 13 of them were found broken and thrown out. Before lunch a volunteer named Hugo brought in 77 tools from a house clearance, more than his colleague Petra had brought all month, and at noon Petra added 52 of her own. During the afternoon 3 tools went missing, and a school workshop borrowed 162. In the evening a member returned 23 tools to the bench. How many tools are on the bench?

Marisol runs a small poster press. In the morning she prepared 205 different poster designs, then printed triple that many sheets by running three copies of each design. A courier arrived with 18 leftover sheets from an earlier job, and she added them to the same stack. In the afternoon an order came in for the whole stack to be duplicated for 6 branch stores, so she printed 6 copies of every sheet she was holding. That evening she shipped 2006 sheets to the distributor and sent 706 misprinted sheets away to be recycled. How many sheets did Marisol still have at the end of the day?

Dev counted 66 seed packets in his shed, more than his neighbour Lena had in hers. He discarded 59 packets that had split open in the damp. Each of the packets he kept contained exactly 4 sunflower seeds. Lena then gave him a gift that doubled the number of seeds he was holding. Dev planted 43 seeds along the fence that afternoon and later added 16 loose seeds he found in his coat pocket. Lena's own greenhouse has 30 shelves. How many sunflower seeds does Dev have now?

The corner shelf in Ms. Okoye's classroom held 176 books at the start of term. In September students donated 19 more books to that shelf. In October 192 books were taken off the shelf and boxed up for a new school. Later in the term a parent brought 15 books for the corner shelf. The school library then transferred another 68 books onto it. How many books are on the corner shelf now?

The school marching band logs its rehearsal time in minutes rather than in hours. On Monday the band rehearsed for 147 minutes, and on Tuesday for another 72 minutes. Wednesday's session ran 80 minutes and Thursday's ran 72 minutes. On Friday, when half the band arrived late, they still managed 45 minutes. At the end of the week the director split the total rehearsal time into 4 equal blocks, one block for each piece of music. How many minutes long was one of those blocks?

In the morning the packing line at a hardware plant filled tins with 226 screws in every tin. Each box that came off the line held triple that number, because 3 tins went into every box. By midday the boxes were being stacked 4 to a crate. In the afternoon each pallet was loaded with 6 crates. That evening a lorry was loaded with double a pallet's worth, which is 2 full pallets, and 76 loose screws were tossed into the last gap. How many screws left the plant on the lorry that evening?

Bea keeps all her loose change in a single glass jar on the kitchen shelf. On Monday morning the jar held 33 coins. Before leaving for work she took 21 coins out to pay for the bus. At lunchtime her flatmate dropped in enough coins to double what was in the jar. In the afternoon Bea emptied her wallet and added 75 more coins. That evening she counted out 70 coins for the window cleaner. How many coins are in the jar now?

A garden centre began Monday morning with 141 tomato seedlings on its bench. A delivery brought 30 more before nine o'clock, and a customer returned 4 that would not fit in her car. During the busy afternoon 117 seedlings were sold. In the evening head office arranged for each of its 7 branches to stock exactly as many seedlings as this branch had left. A dozen watering cans hung on the wall above the bench. The next morning a grower donated 70 extra seedlings to the company. How many tomato seedlings does the company have in total now?

Sam and Nora dry apple rings on their farm, and Nora peels faster than Sam does. One morning they packed 123 apples equally into 3 crates, and by the end of the week the orchard had filled 6 crates holding the same number of apples as one of those. Every apple in those crates was sliced into 8 rings, and the rings were threaded onto strings with 3 rings on each string. At the farmers' market they sold 461 strings straight away. Their stall prices everything in whole dollars rather than in cents, and each string they still have is priced at 6 dollars. How many dollars will Sam and Nora take in if they sell all of their remaining strings?

Otis keeps every one of his model-railway track pieces in a single wooden box. On Saturday morning the box held 90 pieces, and he lent half of them to his cousin for the day. Before lunch he traded away 40 more pieces at the club swap table. In the afternoon his cousin returned the loan in a way that doubled whatever was left in the box. That evening Otis bought 39 pieces from a stall and dropped them in. On Sunday the club exchanged his whole box for 7 sets, each containing exactly as many pieces as his box had held. How many track pieces does Otis own now?

The Wednesday quiz team keeps all of its prize money in one tin. The tin held 195 dollars at the start of the season. After the first quiz the team added 66 dollars, and the second quiz brought in another 31 dollars. A raffle added 68 dollars to the tin and a member's donation added 20 dollars more. The quiz nights are always held in room 12 of the community hall. At the end of the season the whole tin was divided equally into 4 envelopes. How many dollars were in one of those envelopes?

Lucia lays bricks faster than her apprentice Theo does. On Monday Lucia unloaded 8 pallets, each holding 134 bricks, into one stack. She used 540 of those bricks on a garden wall and then found 7 spare bricks behind the shed. Theo ordered 9 times that many bricks for a much bigger job at the school and had them all added to the stack. Of that big delivery, 2824 bricks were built into the school wall, and 9 unused bricks were later returned to the stack. How many bricks are in the stack now?

Hana and her brother Ali both collect conkers, and Ali always finds more of them than Hana does. Hana set out with 57 conkers in her bag and picked up 10 more along the lane. She handed 31 of them to Ali for his own collection. At the park she emptied two more identical bags into hers, tripling the number she was carrying. She then gave 43 conkers to a school art project. In the village championship every conker a player brings is worth 6 points, and all 4 players on Hana's team brought exactly as many conkers as Hana had. How many points did Hana's team score altogether?

The Riverside Cinema had 189 tubs of popcorn ready before the matinee. The kiosk staff made up 32 more tubs, a colleague carried in 5 tubs from the storeroom, and a late delivery added 61 more. The evening rush was expected to be busy, so the manager had the whole stock doubled by opening a second machine. The cinema has 12 screens. Head office then asked each of its 7 branches to have exactly as many tubs ready as Riverside had. How many tubs of popcorn were ready across all 7 branches?

Priya and Owen look after the school stationery cupboard, and Priya keeps a tidier record than Owen does. The cupboard held 157 notebooks in September, and 47 of them were damp and had to be thrown out. Owen then ordered 5 boxes, each holding as many notebooks as the cupboard had left. During the year 487 notebooks were handed out to students and another 42 went to the exam hall. A parents' group donated 74 notebooks in the summer term. The office writes its stock figures in single notebooks rather than in boxes, and next year each of the 8 year groups is to be given a stock the same size as what remains. How many notebooks will the school need for all 8 year groups?

Tariq bakes more bread rolls each morning than his colleague Meena does. On Friday Tariq filled 8 trays with 82 rolls on every tray and emptied them all onto the counter. The cafe sold 121 rolls before ten o'clock. Meena then brought out 55 rolls she had baked earlier and a delivery van dropped off 19 more. A cancelled order put another 25 rolls back on the counter. How many bread rolls were on the counter after that?

A city bike-share station is checked three times a day, and its records are kept in whole hours rather than in minutes. At the start of Monday morning the station had 150 bicycles in its racks. A delivery lorry arrived and doubled that number before eight o'clock. During the afternoon commute half of all the bicycles at the station were ridden away and never returned. In the evening 22 bicycles were taken to the workshop for repair. The city now plans 7 stations of exactly this size, each holding as many bicycles as this one ended the day with. How many bicycles will the city need for the 7 stations?

Delia keeps all her savings in one online account, which is recorded in whole dollars rather than in cents. The account held 21 dollars at the end of April. She deposited 78 dollars from a weekend job and 38 dollars from selling an old bicycle. In May she withdrew 66 dollars for a concert ticket and 7 dollars for a bus pass. Her bank branch is open 6 days a week. In June her aunt transferred 43 dollars into the same account. How many dollars are in Delia's account now?

Noor and her teammate Jasper stock the school tuck shop, and Noor fills more shelves than Jasper does. On Monday Noor put 64 juice cartons in the fridge, and Jasper doubled that number by adding an identical amount. Half of the cartons in the fridge were sold during the week. The tuck shop counter is 3 metres long. Another 15 cartons were taken for the sports day picnic. For the school fair the caterer ordered 6 fridges stocked with exactly as many cartons as this fridge then held, and 6 loose cartons were added to that order. How many juice cartons does the fair order come to?

A plant nursery measures its beds in metres rather than in centimetres, and it counts everything else one by one. Early on Saturday morning the nursery had 171 seed trays in the shed, but 126 of them were cracked and were thrown away. Each of the good trays holds 8 planting cells. In the afternoon every one of those cells was sown with 8 seeds. The greenhouse is 24 metres long. By the evening count, half of all the seeds sown that day had failed to come up. How many of the seeds sown that day came up?

Bramble Farm keeps a careful record of the hens in its main coop. The coop held 138 hens in January, and 63 of them were moved to a neighbour's farm in February. In March 33 chicks that had grown up joined the coop, and in April another 26 hens arrived. A further 16 hens were bought in May, while 46 were sold at the summer market. The farmer now plans to build 8 coops on the hillside, each holding exactly as many hens as the main coop holds today. Half of the farm's fields lie beyond the stream. How many hens will the 8 new coops hold in total?

Yusuf and his cousin Amara sell second-hand comics together, and Yusuf owns more of them than Amara does. Yusuf's crate held 141 comics until Amara doubled the contents by adding an identical collection of her own. A car-boot seller threw in 23 more comics for free. At the fair 139 comics were sold from the crate. A school donated 58 comics to the pair that afternoon, and 22 comics were later found to be water-damaged and thrown out. How many comics are in the crate now?

On Monday morning Ines counted 133 bags of compost in the garden centre yard, and her colleague Dmitri wheeled in 64 more, though Ines shifts more bags in a day than Dmitri does. By lunchtime 170 bags had been sold to landscapers. In the afternoon head office arranged for each of its 7 regional yards to hold the same number of bags as this yard, and that became the whole regional stock. That evening 76 bags were loaded onto a lorry for a golf course. A late cancellation brought 40 bags back into the regional stock. How many bags of compost were in the regional stock at the end of the day?

Nadia manages a paper mill store and orders more stock than her colleague Ravi ever does. She took in 9 pallets of paper, each holding 195 reams, and stacked them all in one store room. A large print job used 215 reams from that room. Ravi returned 44 reams his department had not needed, and a supplier sent 41 more as a goodwill gesture. The company now wants 7 store rooms, each stocked with exactly as many reams as Nadia's room holds. How many reams will the 7 store rooms hold altogether?

On Monday morning Kwame and his sister Adjoa counted the hens in the first hen house: Kwame counted 98 of them and Adjoa found 15 more hiding in the yard, and Kwame always counts faster than Adjoa does. Over the following week each of those hens laid 8 eggs. The farm has 9 hen houses, every one holding exactly the same number of hens as the first. On Saturday evening all of the eggs were packed into cartons holding 3 eggs each. How many cartons did the farm fill?
